changelog: - **A connection named in a review line reads from its start to its end in every language.** When a proposal's review refused or warned about a connection, the line named it by its two ends, "Hopper → Drum". In the Arabic interface that pair was laid out by the script of its first name, so with an Arabic first name it read the other way round from the Inspector, the arrow pointing at the start. A list of several names in one review line took the direction of the first name in the same way. The review now isolates each name once, keeps a connection's two names and its arrow in one left-to-right run as the Inspector shows it, and keeps each name of a list in its own direction.
